description: veil 0.10 reverse proxy from its published container image (full-container build: epoll readiness reactor, no tokio), one process with four listeners. A Proxy-Wasm module loaded into veil answers /baseline11 (including the POST body), /baseline2, /pipeline and /json/{count}, serializing the JSON body per request from the dataset veil loads at startup; /static/* is veil's File backend (sendfile, on-the-fly compression on every protocol, caches that follow the disk). TLS via rustls: HTTP/1.1 on :8081, h2 and h3 (quiche) on :8443, h2c on :8082.
